services.desc: Explore the 1800s at the Granger Homestead and Carriage Museum. Our creative educational tours and programs are aligned with New York State Learning Standards and inspire the interest of students in core subjects including Language Arts, Social Studies, and U.S. History. We are an extension of the classroom, bringing both local and United States history to life. Boy and Girl Scouts of all ages can earn a variety of badges or simply enjoy a day at the Homestead.
